2: For the Chief Musician. By the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
3: Therefore we won't be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas;
4: though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains tremble with their swelling. Selah.
5: There is a river, the streams of which make the city of God glad, the holy place of the tents of the Most High.
6: God is in her midst. She shall not be moved. God will help her at dawn.
7: The nations raged. The kingdoms were moved. He lifted his voice, and the earth melted.
8: The Lord of hosts is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
9: Come, see the Lord 's works, what desolations he has made in the earth.
10: He makes wars cease to the end of the earth. He breaks the bow, and shatters the spear. He burns the chariots in the fire.
11: "Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted in the earth."
12: The Lord of hosts is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
